# dreamrouter_ssh (Resource)

The router's SSH settings: SSH to the router itself, and SSH to adopted devices such as access points. Leave an attribute out to leave that setting alone. There is one of these per router; destroying the resource leaves SSH as it is. Passwords are not managed here: turning router SSH on keeps the root password set before.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Keep SSH to the router off, and SSH to access points on.
resource "dreamrouter_ssh" "this" {
  router  = false
  devices = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `devices` (Boolean) Whether SSH to adopted devices is on (Network: Device SSH Authentication). Every change makes the router issue its devices a new internal API token, so it is only written when it changes.
- `router` (Boolean) Whether SSH to the router itself is on (UniFi OS: Control Plane → Console → SSH).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always "ssh".

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Manage the existing SSH settings:
terraform import dreamrouter_ssh.this ssh
```
